name: Unturned
hint: Zombie survival sandbox server, joined by Server Code

UPDATE_CHECK.title: Update check interval
UPDATE_CHECK.description: Minutes between checks for Unturned updates; the server restarts to apply one, since players must run the same version. Players join by entering the 17-digit Server Code from the app's logs (printed once the level has loaded) in the game's Connect Directly menu. It goes through Steam Datagram Relay and changes on every restart.
